method: Retain all 165 earlier complete 15-cog cases and append the 200 newly audited cross-sheet groups, with the same 18 original frames. Preserve every source candidate and exact global index. Recompute every bracket/insert compatibility against frames and each unique cog pose, retaining every small pose compatible with at least one whole case. For each distinct added-case/sheet/neighborhood absent from the prior query set, generate all eight bracket orientation/reflection and two insert size classes with translated zero-origin Minkowski caches. Share queries only when the exact ordered neighbor ids, sheet and moving orientation match. Process representatives, boundary vertices and midpoints round-robin under fresh family caps; preserve every rejected/duplicate event and pending suffix. Groups are discrete choices, not independent cog variables. Retain the prior checked 63-part case-144 seed. Audit the full changed compatibility and small-pair graph. Allow a new bounded same-family substitution only when the replacement is adjacent, its other full-graph neighbors are a subset, and it is compatible with every complete group allowed by the removed candidate. Independently enumerate every certificate, project every retained conflict, and preserve exact counts/area and group choice. Compare bounded greedy starts across all 365 groups, then make at most one new group-selection solver call after independent checks. Do not reuse earlier substitution certificates or resume the 980 old capped lists.
scope: This adds the missing 10+5, 12+3 and alternative 14+1 sheet distributions to the complete-group decision; it is not a retry or time extension of either previous model. Finite sampled contacts do not establish continuous impossibility. Native margins, original repair limits/budget and full H5 remain required.
